name: Entity Hierarchy Widgets
description: provides widgets to display and manage hierarchical structures from Entity Hierarchy.
project_description:
Additions to Entity Reference module.

Adds widgets for management of hierarchically referenced entities.

 Features 
 - Adds a drag and drop interface for reorganizing hirarchically organized entities - for the whole tree, not only children.

- Adds an additional selection widget similar to the one used for hirarchical taxonomy terms.

- Adds a block that displays the hierarchy of the currently displayed entity.

 Post-Installation 
 - Adjust permission to use the hierarchy management form.

- Konfigure selection widget.

- Place block if desired. 

 Additional Requirements 
 Depends on Entity Reference Hierarchy module 5.x
